name: Enter ORACLY and open the daily guidance
description: Verifies the shareable web build reaches the core ORACLY experience and opens daily guidance on desktop.
expected: The Daily Reading screen is visible with interactive guidance content.

name: Complete a three-card tarot reading and retain it in history
description: Verifies a tarot reading can be completed and remains available in the local history after refresh.
steps: Select three cards and wait for the reading result
expected: A Three Card Reading entry remains visible in History after refresh.

name: Use zodiac and compatibility tools
description: Verifies zodiac guidance and compatibility remain usable on a mobile-sized browser as well as desktop.
steps: Return to Home and open Compatibility
expected: A horoscope detail screen is shown for Leo and the compatibility score updates when a sign changes.

name: Toggle TikTok Live Mode on desktop
description: Verifies the desktop-only live presentation mode enlarges the experience and can be toggled back off.
expected: Live Mode activates with a larger presentation and then returns to the normal desktop layout.
